title: Fix N+1 query in MessageStore::list_by_chat attachment loading
description:
MessageStore::list_by_chat() does N+1 SQLite queries: 1 for messages + N for attachments (one per message). For 100-message lists this is 101 queries.

Fix: use a single batch query with WHERE message_id IN (...) to load all attachments for all messages in one round trip, then group by message_id and assign.

File: crates/kith-store/src/message.rs — list_by_chat() method.
